key_idea: A green+red pair gives 10 per green, far better than any green-only recipe, so pair as many as possible and then pack leftover greens in threes.
sketch: Use p=min(g,r) pairs for 10p. With the remaining greens take g/3 triples for 10 each, and the remainder gives 3 if it is 2 or 1 if it is 1. Leftover reds are worthless. O(1).
